exclusions.source_text: Any infant who, in the opinion of his or her pediatrician or the investigators, has a major medical problem (such as cardiac pathology or airway obstruction) that makes participation in the study difficult

Patients with asthma or a history of asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or cardiovascular disease, including sinus bradycardia, second or third degree atrioventricular block, overt cardiac failure, and cardiogenic shock
